thread:
maya: Heads-up — I found a tenant-facing freshness gap in aggregates for org 'clearwave'. window ~2026-03-10 00:00 -> 2026-03-13 23:59. counts off by ~18% on sessions. cc @replay-bot :eyes:
liam: ugh. source looks like late kafka-partition ingestion + a couple of late joins. do we want a straight rehydrate or staged replay with validation?
sasha: Staged. we should run a dry-run recompute for the 72h slice first and diff the aggregates in S3 before promoting. avoids accidental double-counting.
maya: Agree. can the console show the diff preview? that was supposed to be in the replay UX pilot.
ash: (typo) meant to ping @ashley — Ashley, is the "preview diffs" toggle ready in the console?
ash: sorry, sasha -> that's maya
ashley: The preview is in the feature-flagged console branch. It shows per-tenant delta estimates but not row-level sampling yet. We can turn it on for clearwave and surface the estimated impacted tokens + cardinality.
liam: What's the cost estimate for a dry-run over 72h for that tenant (tokens / compute hours)? need to check quota impact.
ashley: Quick estimate: dry-run map-recompute job ~ 1.8 vGPU-hours, replay mapreduce ~ 0.8 slot-hours. rough token equivalent ~ 4.5M tokens processed. If we run in priority-lane it won't affect default backfills.
maya: How do we ensure routing goes to Dedicated vs Shared? clearwave is on mid-tier reserved capacity. If the replay lands on shared and spikes, it could throttle other backfills.
sasha: We should pin to dedicated pool for the primary pass and allow shared for re-tries with low QoS. Also enforce rate-limit: --target-rps 30 and backpressure based on ingest-slo.
liam: Can we use adaptive-priority-lane? earlier RFC had weight-based routing: tenants with >10% SLA hits get weighted into priority lanes. clearwave is near threshold.
ashley: That RFC exists but not wired to the console UI toggles yet. ops-bot can route by --pool=dedicated if we annotate the job. I'll add a checkbox to the console to 'Run on Dedicated'.
replay-bot: scheduled replay job created: replay-3842104321-clearwave-dryrun. Status: queued. link: https://console.redwood.ai/replays/3842104321
maya: Perfect. let's run dry-run, get diff, then schedule full recompute with a 2-step rollout: 10%->50%->100% tenant slices. we'll lock a canary window (02:00-04:00 UTC) to reduce user impact.
liam: For the rollout automation: can we reuse the existing rollout controller? it supports percentage ramps but needs a safety check hook to abort on negative diffs >2%.
sasha: I'll add a transient check: compare 'sessions_unique' metric in the canary slice vs baseline; if abs(delta) > 2% abort and notify #incidents.
maya: Owners: maya (issue lead), ashley (console flags + routing checkbox), sasha (safety checks), liam (quota/cost sign-off). timeline: dry-run tonight -> diff by tomorrow morning -> canary full recompute tomorrow 02:00 UTC if green.
liam: Also add a console warning about estimated cost before confirm. small UX ask.
ashley: On it. I'll enable preview and the dedicated checkbox for the org; will post a short demo GIF in the channel when ready.
maya: Thanks. tagging follow-ups: create a short postmortem template in case we need rollback, and record the canary thresholds in the replay job metadata.
sasha: note: remember to exclude late-joining events that arrived after 2026-03-14 00:00, we don't want to retroactively shift windows. use watermark = 2026-03-13T23:59:59Z.
replay-bot: dry-run started: replay-3842104321-clearwave-dryrun -> running on dedicated pool. ETA ~ 42m.
liam: I'll watch quota dashboards and pause other low-priority replays if we see spillover. :thumbsup:
maya: Great, will report back with the diff. thanks all!
